title: Limetree Bay Flare #8 / Phase 2 purge — prerequisite-to-transition challenge

source.facility: Limetree Bay Refining, St. Croix, U.S. Virgin Islands
source.context: long-term shutdown; Flare #8 testing and Phase 2 hydrocarbon purge controls
source.binding_method: official EPA domain + facility identity + dated Phase 1 plan + dated Phase 2 pending-approval letter + dated EPA community update
source.terminology_note: The Phase 1 plan uses Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR); the August 23 Phase 2 letter uses Pre-startup Review (PSR). This challenge preserves the source terminology rather than normalizing them as identical legal terms.

historical_evidence_cutoff.basis: Evidence, submissions, and controls available before EPA's written approval allowing Phase 2 to commence.
historical_evidence_cutoff.rule: Later EPA status updates may establish subsequent operational state but are not backfilled as evidence available before approval.

source_locators.fact: The plan called for safety-system tests, loop checks of flare temperature, pressure, flow, and level devices from field device to DCS, stroking control valves from the DCS to confirm field operation, control-logic checks, and completion of a Pre-Startup Safety Review.

The plan states that valves at refinery process units were closed and locked, visual surveys with documented sign-offs were available, and a mechanical blind isolated the refinery flare system from Flare #8 during Phase 1 testing.

Before EPA would approve the Phase 2 purge plan, Limetree was required to provide a Pre-startup Review for Flare #8 completed up to the unblinding step, certify that staff performing Phase 2 work were properly trained in applicable procedures, and submit specified additional Phase 2 safety and process information.

After the additional information was submitted and EPA approved the Phase 2 purge plan in writing, Limetree was required to submit the final completed Flare #8 PSR within one business day of unblinding and continue recurring Phase 2 reporting and compliance obligations.

source_locators.source: EPA Limetree case page and August 27, 2021 community update
source_locators.fact: EPA states that Phase 1 was successfully completed on July 31, 2021, EPA approved the Phase 2 Plan and Timeline, and Phase 2 began on August 27, 2021.

contemporaneous_plan_and_evidence: A documented Phase 1 test plan covered safety-system testing.
The plan specified loop checks for temperature, pressure, flow, and level devices from field device to DCS.
The plan specified stroking control valves from the DCS and confirming operation in the field.
The plan specified control-logic checks using simulated field inputs and confirmation of automatic field action.
The plan stated that process-unit valves were closed and locked and that visual surveys with documented sign-offs were available.
The plan required a PSSR as part of Phase 1 testing.
EPA later reported Phase 1 successfully completed on July 31, 2021.
contemporaneous_known_requirements_and_b: EPA written approval was required before the Phase 2 purge plan could proceed.
A Flare #8 PSR completed up to the unblinding step was a pre-approval requirement.
A certification that staff performing Phase 2 work were properly trained in applicable procedures was a pre-approval requirement.
Additional safety/process descriptions and supporting information identified by EPA were required before written approval.
Within one business day of unblinding Flare #8, the final completed PSR was required to be submitted to EPA.

human_or_regulatory_decision.decision: EPA approval of the Phase 2 Plan and Timeline
human_or_regulatory_decision.decision_effect: permission for the approved Phase 2 long-term shutdown work to proceed subject to the stated controls and continuing obligations

subsequent_operational_state.note: The selected EPA records establish approval and Phase 2 commencement, but this challenge does not infer the exact unblinding time or completion of every post-unblinding obligation without a direct artifact.

field_probes.reason: The selected evidence describes safety-system tests and instrument loop checks, not a qualifying frozen-contract pressure-test result.

The Phase 1 plan reports process-unit valves closed and locked and a blind installed for the Phase 1 test configuration, but that bounded configuration is not coerced into the frozen Gas Site Readiness isolation-readiness boolean.
The selected records do not establish the frozen contract's fire-protection readiness fact.
The selected records do not establish the frozen contract's leak-detection requirement fact.
Safety-system and flare-control tests are not treated as a gas leak-detection automatic-shutoff witness.
EPA approval and required submissions are not coerced into the frozen contract's pre-operation notification evidence field.
The selected records do not establish warning-sign installation.

unrepresentable_or_differently_scoped_se: staged regulatory approval before a physical/process boundary may be crossed
personnel training certification as a release prerequisite
a pre-boundary partial review followed by a post-boundary final-review submission deadline
continuing reporting and compliance obligations after release

paygod_execution.reason: No faithful complete frozen Gas Site Readiness input can be produced from the selected EPA records without inventing unrelated readiness booleans.

gap_assessment.diagnostic_observation: The EPA workflow links pre-transition prerequisites to written approval, permits a bounded operational transition, and imposes a timed post-transition evidence obligation. Whether that pattern belongs inside Gas Site Readiness, a separate domain Pack, or a reusable cross-domain extension must not be decided before mapping review.

non_claims: PayGod does not substitute for EPA, issue regulatory approvals, or prove legal compliance.

The exact Flare #8 unblinding timestamp is not asserted.
The final post-unblinding PSR submission is not claimed as retrieved or independently verified in this challenge.
